rules.source: policy.VOL_RULES, set from the backtest verdicts

model.iv_model: ATM = VIX, VIX3M at 90d by total variance, fixed skew

short_condor_pays.claim: a short condor sold when implied exceeds forecast realised, outside stress, off the FOMC and off an inverted curve, earns its premium

stress_gate_helps.claim: the stress / inversion / FOMC gate improves the average condor over selling always

iv_rank_gate_helps.claim: requiring IV rank >= 0.50 before selling improves the average condor (Nelson's IV-rank table)

buy_when_cheap.claim: a straddle bought at the cheap end of the cone with a catalyst inside the window pays (the flow matrix's long-vega play)

calendar_on_inversion.claim: a calendar opened on an inverted term structure, outside stress, pays as contango returns

ovx_lead.claim: a rise in crude implied vol leads a WIDER equity VRP the following week (Nelson 2025)

ovx_test.verdict: established in the OPPOSITE direction: a crude-vol rise is followed by a NARROWER equity premium

caveat: Suggest-only; nothing here is executed. The strategy's evidence is a synthetic backtest — no option prices are stored for 2008-2026, so every option in it is priced by Black-Scholes off VIX with a fixed skew, which understates what a short condor loses in a crash and what a long straddle makes. Thresholds were chosen looking at that backtest. Sizing is per $100k of an options sleeve that is not funded.
